none: PAS NLM-1D7183: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Constantine from Bonby
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy. Coin. Nummus of House of Constantine, issue of 348-350, Reece period 18. Obverse description: Bust draped and diademed right. Obverse inscription: [--]ON[--]P[---]. Reverse description: Emperor standing left on galley holding labarum with Victory in stern. Reverse inscription: FEL TEMP [REPARATIO]. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin. Diameter: 20.4mm, Weight: 4.45gms, die…
